author: River Bend Times
title: Miller-Meeks urges congressional action on banning stock trades by lawmakers
text:
Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, U.S. Representative for Iowa's 1st District | Official U.S. House headshot
Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, U.S. Representative for Iowa's 1st District | Official U.S. House headshot
Congresswoman Mariannette Miller-Meeks (IA-01) has called on the House Committee on Administration to move forward with legislation that would ban members of Congress and their spouses from buying or selling individual stocks while in office.
Miller-Meeks is a cosponsor of the Restore Trust in Congress Act, which seeks to prohibit lawmakers and their immediate families from owning or trading individual stocks. She urged House leadership to prioritize this reform.
“Iowans expect, and deserve, a Congress that works for them, not for personal profit,” said Miller-Meeks. “Members of Congress should not be trading individual stocks while writing laws and receiving nonpublic briefings. It’s time to end this practice, restore trust, and make sure the decisions we make are driven solely by the people we serve.”
In a letter addressed to Chairman Bryan Steil and Ranking Member Joe Morelle, Miller-Meeks called for a comprehensive package including a full ban on stock trading by members of Congress and their spouses, alternatives such as blind trusts or diversified funds, and strict enforcement with penalties for violations.
She emphasized that bipartisan proposals already exist and said the committee could bring these ideas together into enforceable reform. According to Miller-Meeks, public support for such a ban is strong.
“Congress must prove that we put the public’s interest ahead of our own,” she wrote. “A stock-trading ban is common sense, long overdue, and overwhelmingly supported by the American people.”
Miller-Meeks stated that neither she nor her husband own any individual stocks.
Miller-Meeks has represented Iowa’s 1st District in Congress since 2021 after previously serving in the Iowa Senate from 2019 to 2021. She was born in Herlong, California in 1955 and currently resides in Le Claire. She earned her BSN from Texas Christian University in 1976.
